# Subagent UX — Feature Preview

Screenshots captured from the dev sandbox (`docker-compose.dev.yml`) with mock subagent state injected.

---

## TaskToolEntry — live subagent status in parent chat

When an agent fires a `Task` tool, the parent chat now shows a live-updating entry instead of the old generic "used task 1 time" summary row.

- **Header**: `▸ Delegated to subagent` · `● running` (blue pulse dot)
- **Live status**: `↳ Read src/components/Button/Button.tsx` — updates in real-time as the child runs tools
- Clicking the row navigates to the child session

![TaskToolEntry in parent chat](data:image/png;base64,)

---

## SubagentBanner — navigate back to parent

When viewing a child (subagent) session, a slim bar appears directly above the composer showing which session spawned it. Clicking the underlined link focuses the parent session.

![SubagentBanner above composer](data:image/png;base64,)

The bar renders between the status row and the composer:

```
↑ Subagent  ·  feat/data-visualization · atls-1   ← clickable link
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
(default) ▾  Claude Code                    Ready
Type a message…                                 ▶
```

## How it works

| Scenario | What you see |
|----------|-------------|
| Agent fires `Task` tool, child session not yet created | `TaskToolEntry` shows "Delegated to subagent" with spinner |
| Child session created (`session:created` WS event with `spawnedFrom`) | FIFO-matched to the task entry; live `↳ {tool} {file}` appears |
| Child session completes | Entry switches to result summary text |
| Viewing the child session | `SubagentBanner` appears above Composer; click → parent focused |
| Multiple concurrent task tools | Each gets its own child session in FIFO order |
| Reload / reconnect | `childByParent` rebuilt from sessions list — no WS events needed |

> **steer() mid-turn injection** (Phase 5): when you type while a turn is already running and the queue is empty, the message is injected via ACP `_session/steering` — the agent sees it immediately without the current turn cancelling. The send button label changes to "Interrupts and steers the running turn" when `canSteer` is true.
